_about: The demo's factions (four, then eight from FACTIONS [more banners] 10/18, then twelve from FACTIONS [home bases] 10/18: rule 42a's human floor, the keepers, the eye in the sky, the block watch and the runners) as one table RUN's parties and the map card read (VAMILY rows [the parties on the map] and [a house you give a fuck about], rule 80c). Every faction has a banner ink, a party make-up (enemy ids from enemies.json, counts from party_math.json), a home ground, a behaviour, and a FACE, a WANT and a BASE. Mixes and behaviours are Battle Brothers' and cite the wiki; banner inks, wants, face slots and voice lines are OURS and marked ours/draft. A face id is a SLOT for PEOPLE and PORTRAIT to fill (portrait:null until they do); nothing here names a person. No purple (PURPLE RESERVATION).

banner_rule.value: a faction's ink is nobody else's; chosen by CIEDE2000 distance from every shipped faction colour in engine/BOHEMIA_faction_colours.json
banner_rule.why: free hues are nearly used up; orange, cyan and mint were the three furthest from the rest

factions.name: Road crews
factions.behaviour_quote: In the early game Brigand groups usually consist of Thugs and sometimes Raiders.

face.role: the crew's boss on the party card

voice.text: Esta carretera es nuestra. Pay the toll or walk.

want.text: to own the freeway and tax everyone on it
want.source: VAMILY row [a house you give a fuck about]

base.note: a home base on the map (WORLD's BohemiaTowns seat); which seat is RUN's read

factions.ground_note: the freeway is the crew's want (VAMILY row); the hills are the wiki's wilderness line (ground_quote)

ground_quote.quote: Brigands live in the woods, hills, and wilderness around the human settlements

leaders.why: a leader stays at its authored count whatever the party size: Battle Brothers' leaders come one to a band ('It's rare to see simultaneously more than one', bb_all/0290_Brigand Leader.txt)

value.warm: Para ti, amigo, no toll. Pero no le digas a nadie.

FACTIONS [home bases] 10/18 handed the suburb blocks to the block watch and the lots to the runners: a house owns the valley, the neighbours defend the houses (Battle Brothers 1.1: every settlement is a house's, and its militia still defend it)

ground_quote.quote: These settlements will spawn patrols, which secure the streets between the settlements of their house.

leaders.why: a leader stays at its authored count whatever the party size; ours, draft

value.cold: The House remembers what you did. The depot is closed to you.
value.neutral: The House needs the depot kept. Do you work for hire?
value.warm: The House remembers who kept its roads. There is a place at the board for you.

ground_quote.quote: They travel the barren desert from one source of water to the next

value.neutral: Agua por baterias, amigo. One jug, one cell, no haggle.

factions.mix_note: ours, from the wiki's line 'They consist of highly skilled Mercenaries that are well armed and armored. Some companies spawn together with Hedge Knights, Swordmasters, Master Archers' (bb_all/1260_Mercenary Companies.txt): plain mercenaries early, the named three join late
factions.ground_note: the hired guns stand where the money is: the Strip still pays in batteries; Battle Brothers' companies take contracts from settlements (behaviour_quote), and in this valley the settlement with money is the Strip; the casino floor inside it is the house security's since FACTIONS [home bases] 10/18

leaders.why: a mercenary company has no leader unit in the wiki's roster (bb_all/1260_Mercenary Companies.txt names Mercenaries, Hedge Knights, Swordmasters, Master Archers, Wardogs), so none is held to one

value.neutral: We go where the money goes. Pay us more than they do, es simple.

factions.behaviour_source: reference/library/grok/wiki/PAGES_ALL.tar.gz bb_all/0594_Dev Blog 116: The Barbarians, Part I.txt
factions.behaviour_quote: They roam the harsh and infertile lands as they have been for hundreds of years

want.text: to keep the herd fed, whoever it has to eat from
want.quote: The barbarians attack you and want to raid the settlement that gave you the contract afterwards.

base.note: the keepers' camp on the open desert below the springs at Corn Creek, the wildlife refuge north of the city (records/target/bb/region_bases.json hostile_locations corn_creek_keepers, FACTIONS [four seated] 10/18); a camp that moves with the herd ('They roam the harsh and infertile lands', bb_all/0594), the camp a contract sends you to (bb_all/0667_Drive Away Barbarians.txt)

factions.mix_note: ours, shaped on the wiki's tactics (bb_all/0195_Barbarians.txt): 'Even their weakest units, Thralls, often have throwing weapons' early, with the dogs; 'In the late game you will encounter armored Chosen... Also their Armored Unholds will appear, and Beastmasters to control them' late. THE KEEPERS ARE THE LAB-BREAKOUT PEOPLE (records/BOHEMIA_BATTLE_BROTHERS_SCHOOL_THE_BESTIARY_COUNT_9_29_26.md): the Armored Unhold is the lab's plated short-faced bear or ground sloth, the warhound a dog

factions.name: The block watch
factions.behaviour_quote: If hostile troops raid a village or town, a group of militia soldiers spawn, ready to defend their homes and families.

face.role: the block captain on the party card

voice.text: Nadie comes down this street at night, so say your business.

want.text: to keep the block standing and strangers walking
want.quote: when enemies come close, can send militia squads to fight them.

base.note: no seat, on purpose, the Battle Brothers way: the watch is the neighbours ('ready to defend their homes and families', bb_all/0724) of every town and camp, gathered when a hostile party comes close and disbanded after ('Militia forces can be gathered when a hostile party is sighted close to a settlement', the same page); it turns out at every town or camp a crew is going at (records/target/bb/wants.json keep-the-block turns_out, FACTIONS [four seated] 10/18); a richer block fields more ('A rich town can field more militia than a poor town.', the same page)

factions.mix_note: ours, shaped on the wiki's militia list (bb_all/0724_Factions and Relations.txt: Militia, Militia Marksman, Militia Veteran, Militia Captain): neighbours and armed peasants early, veterans and a captain late ('A prosperous settlement might have a militia captain, an experienced veteran who provides them with a morale bonus.')
factions.ground_note: the suburb blocks are where people still live in houses; Battle Brothers' militia defend their homes (ground_quote), so the watch holds the houses (FACTIONS [home bases] 10/18 moved the suburb block from the house to the watch; the house keeps the depots and the green)

ground_quote.quote: If hostile troops raid a village or town, a group of militia soldiers spawn, ready to defend their homes and families.

leaders.why: one captain to a watch: 'A prosperous settlement might have a militia captain' (bb_all/0724)

value.neutral: Nadie comes down this street at night, so say your business.
value.warm: Mijo, you look after this block and this block looks after you.

factions.name: The runners
factions.behaviour_quote: Instead of brute force they usually ambush their enemies.

face.role: the dispatcher who sends the runners, on the party card

voice.text: Anything across the valley by sundown, para cash or batteries.

want.text: to hit what stands near the lots and be gone before anybody shoots
want.quote: Instead of brute force they usually ambush their enemies.

base.note: the runners' lot at the Valley of Fire visitor centre in the red rock past the lake (records/target/bb/region_bases.json hostile_locations valley_of_fire_runners, FACTIONS [four seated] 10/18); a dead lot with the bikes and the quads in it (ours); Battle Brothers' goblins keep camps a contract sends you to (bb_all/0542_Defeat Goblin Location.txt)

factions.mix_note: ours, shaped on the wiki's tactics (bb_all/0878_Goblins.txt: 'Their strategy in general has one main goal: preventing you from starting a proper melee fight'): net-throwers and slingers early; riders late ('Wolfriders are their cavalry. Avoiding direct combat, they try to encircle your squad and strike from behind'), a shaman and one overseer. THE SKIN (the 9/29 draft): runners on bikes and dirt quads with slings and nets; the wolfrider is the quad. THEY ARE GROWN: the 9/29 draft's word 'kids' is a courier's age, never a child; nobody in a fight is a child (ours, draft)
factions.ground_note: the empty lots and the dead big-box stores, where a bike or a quad runs any way it likes; Battle Brothers' goblins live beyond the reach of the towns (ground_quote), and in this valley that is the lot nobody parks in any more (FACTIONS [home bases] 10/18 moved the lots from the house to the runners)

ground_quote.quote: Goblins live in the lands beyond the reach of human civilization

leaders.why: one overseer to a band: the council drafts the lower caste 'led by a Goblin Overseer' (bb_all/0878_Goblins.txt)

value.cold: You will not catch us, pero we will catch you.
value.neutral: Anything across the valley by sundown, para cash or batteries.
value.warm: Amigo, we saw who followed you. We lost them for you.

face portraits are slots, PEOPLE/PORTRAIT fill them
the house has no banner ink: its colour is canon (COLOUR IS TERRITORY)

every board ground is held since FACTIONS [more banners] (10/18): the_strip by the hired guns, trailer_park by the flock, airport by the head takers, solar_and_pumps by the water people; since FACTIONS [home bases] (10/18) casino_floor by the eye in the sky, open_desert by the keepers, suburb_block by the block watch, lot_and_bigbox by the runners; a made-up ground still answers NO_FACTION_HOLDS_THIS_GROUND

the four new factions' grounds, wants and banner inks are ours and draft (FACTIONS [more banners] 10/18); their make-ups are ours except the flock's 25 (the wiki's); no portrait, no art, nothing drawn (the rule-88 hold)

rule 42a's human floor (FACTIONS [home bases] 10/18): eight human factions with rosters (road crews, the house, the hired guns, the keepers, the eye in the sky, the flock, the block watch, the runners, plus the water people and the head takers); their grounds, wants, inks, skins and lines are ours and draft, their make-ups ours on the wiki's rosters; the greenskins' orcs (the heavy) have no row yet; no portrait, no art, nothing drawn (the rule-88 hold)

FACTIONS [four seated] 10/18: every faction's base names its seat (base.seat, a records/target/bb/region_bases.json row id) or carries seat:null with the Battle Brothers reason: the keepers at Corn Creek, the runners at Valley of Fire, the eye in the sky at Lake Las Vegas, the house at the Apex depot; the block watch none (it turns out where crews go), the flock none (met only in events), the hired guns and the head takers none (they roam, roaming_without_a_base); the road crews, the dead, the beasts and the water people are region_bases.json's rows by faction and their base.seat is not written yet (several rows each)

tones.why: the nine relations bands (relations.json, the wiki's) grouped into three things a face can say: cold 0 to 39, neutral 40 to 59, warm 60 to 100. My first version of this file named its own bands (unknown, wary, friendly), which were not the game's; fixed.
